nodes.name: 顺序栈

nodes.definition: 不含任何元素的栈称为空栈。

nodes.name: 中缀转后缀算法
nodes.definition: 中缀转后缀算法：从左到右扫描中缀表达式，操作数直接输出；

section_titles: 3.4.2 中缀表达式与后缀表达式

nodes.name: 共享栈
nodes.definition: 为了提高空间利用率，可以让两个栈共享同一个数组，两个栈底分别设在数组两端，栈顶相向增长，这种结构称为共享栈。

nodes.name: 例 3-1（出栈序列判断
nodes.definition: 例 3-1（出栈序列判断）：元素 1、2、3 依次入栈，判断 3 1 2 是否为合法出栈序列。

nodes.name: 例 3-2（循环队列指针变化
nodes.definition: 例 3-2（循环队列指针变化）：设 MaxSize = 6，初始 front = rear = 0。

nodes.name: 例 3-3（括号匹配
nodes.definition: 例 3-3（括号匹配）：检查串 [(]) 时，读到 ] 时栈顶是 (，类型不符，匹配失败；

nodes.name: 例 3-4（表达式求值
nodes.definition: 例 3-4（表达式求值）：求中缀表达式 (3 + 4) * 2 - 6 / 3 的值。

section_titles: 3.4.2 中缀表达式与后缀表达式

nodes.name: 例 3-5（阶乘的递归计算
nodes.definition: 例 3-5（阶乘的递归计算）：计算 3!

nodes.name: 例 3-6（银行排队模拟
nodes.definition: 例 3-6（银行排队模拟）：银行只有一个窗口，顾客按到达时间依次入队，窗口空闲时让队头顾客出队办理业务。

nodes.name: 递归转非递归
nodes.definition: 借助显式的栈保存待处理的状态，可以把递归算法改写为非递归算法，这种做法称为递归转非递归。

nodes.name: 队头
nodes.definition: 允许插入的一端称为队尾，允许删除的一端称为队头。

nodes.name: 队尾
nodes.definition: 允许插入的一端称为队尾，允许删除的一端称为队头。

nodes.name: 栈顶
nodes.definition: 允许操作的一端称为栈顶，另一端称为栈底。

nodes.name: 后缀表达式求值算法
nodes.definition: 后缀表达式求值算法：从左到右扫描后缀表达式，遇到操作数就入栈；

section_titles: 3.4.2 中缀表达式与后缀表达式

nodes.name: 定理 3.1（出栈序列计数定理
nodes.definition: 定理 3.1（出栈序列计数定理）：n 个不同元素依次入栈，可能得到的不同出栈序列的个数等于第 n 个卡特兰数。

nodes.name: 性质 3.1（合法出栈序列判定
nodes.definition: 性质 3.1（合法出栈序列判定）：一个排列 p1 p2 … pn 是合法出栈序列，当且仅当不存在下标 i < j < k 使得 pj < pk < pi。

nodes.name: 性质 3.2（循环队列判空与判满
nodes.definition: 性质 3.2（循环队列判空与判满）：约定 front 指向队头元素、rear 指向队尾元素的下一个位置，并牺牲一个存储单元，则队空的条件是 front == rear，队满的条件是 (rear + 1) % MaxSize == front。

nodes.name: 后缀表达式
nodes.definition: 把运算符放在两个操作数之后的写法称为后缀表达式，也叫逆波兰式，例如 a b c * +。

section_titles: 3.4.2 中缀表达式与后缀表达式

nodes.name: 中缀表达式
nodes.definition: 日常书写的算术表达式把运算符放在两个操作数中间，称为中缀表达式，例如 a + b * c。

section_titles: 3.4.2 中缀表达式与后缀表达式

nodes.name: 假溢出
nodes.definition: 若每次出队都只让 front 后移，数组前部腾出的空间将无法再利用，可能出现 rear 已到数组末尾而数组前部仍有空位的情况，这种现象称为假溢出。

nodes.name: 递归工作栈
nodes.definition: 递归工作栈是栈在程序运行时的典型应用，理解递归的执行过程要以栈为基础。

nodes.name: 不含任何元素的栈
nodes.definition: 不含任何元素的栈称为空栈。

nodes.name: 为了提高空间
nodes.definition: 为了提高空间利用率，可以让两个栈共享同一个数组，两个栈底分别设在数组两端，栈顶相向增长，这种结构称为共享栈。

nodes.name: 也可以改
nodes.definition: 也可以改用计数变量 size 来区分。

nodes.name: 也就
nodes.definition: 也就是说，若某个较大的元素先出栈，则比它小且仍在栈中的元素必须按从大到小的顺序出栈。

nodes.name: 代价
nodes.definition: 代价是每个结点需要额外的指针域。

nodes.name: 允许插入的一端
nodes.definition: 允许插入的一端称为队尾，允许删除的一端称为队头。

nodes.name: 允许操作的一端
nodes.definition: 允许操作的一端称为栈顶，另一端称为栈底。

nodes.name: 入队
nodes.definition: 入队是在队尾插入元素，出队是删除队头元素。

nodes.name: 凡
nodes.definition: 凡是需要“按到达先后依次处理”的场合，例如任务排队、消息缓冲和逐层访问，适合用队列。

nodes.name: 扫描结束时栈中唯一的元素就
nodes.definition: 扫描结束时栈中唯一的元素就是表达式的值。

section_titles: 3.4.2 中缀表达式与后缀表达式

nodes.name: 把运算符放在两个操作数之后的写法
nodes.definition: 把运算符放在两个操作数之后的写法称为后缀表达式，也叫逆波兰式，例如 a b c * +。

section_titles: 3.4.2 中缀表达式与后缀表达式

nodes.name: 日常书写的算术表达式
nodes.definition: 日常书写的算术表达式把运算符放在两个操作数中间，称为中缀表达式，例如 a + b * c。

nodes.name: 栈和队列
nodes.definition: 栈和队列是两种操作受限的线性表。

nodes.name: 栈和队列都
nodes.definition: 栈和队列都是操作受限的线性表：栈限定在栈顶操作，具有后进先出特性；

nodes.name: 栈的典型应
nodes.definition: 栈的典型应用包括括号匹配、表达式求值和递归，队列的典型应用包括排队服务与广度优先遍历。

nodes.name: 牺牲一个单元
nodes.definition: 牺牲一个单元是为了区分队空和队满这两种状态；

nodes.name: 循环队列
nodes.definition: 课程资料中「3.3.2 循环队列」一节的主题。

nodes.name: 选择使
nodes.definition: 选择使用哪一种结构，关键是看问题要求的处理次序：凡是需要“暂存后逆序处理”的场合，例如撤销操作、回溯搜索和函数调用，适合用栈；

nodes.name: 递归
nodes.definition: 递归是指函数在执行过程中直接或间接调用自身。

nodes.name: 采
nodes.definition: 采用顺序存储的栈称为顺序栈。

nodes.name: 链栈的优点
nodes.definition: 链栈的优点是不存在上溢问题，便于多个栈共享存储空间；

nodes.name: 链栈通常
nodes.definition: 链栈通常用不带头结点的单链表实现，并规定所有操作都在表头进行，表头指针就是栈顶指针。

nodes.name: 顺序存储的优点
nodes.definition: 顺序存储的优点是结构简单、访问局部性好，缺点是容量需要事先确定；

neo4j_operations.query_template: MERGE (g:DraftWriteGuard {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) SET g.seq = coalesce(g.seq, 0) + 1 RETURN g.seq AS seq, size($effective_task_ids) AS visible_tasks

MATCH (:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) -[r {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}]-> (:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) WHERE $task_id IN coalesce(r.contrib_tasks, []) AND $effective_task_ids IS NOT NULL SET r.contrib_tasks = [t IN r.contrib_tasks WHERE t <> $task_id], r.source_pairs = [p IN coalesce(r.source_pairs, []) WHERE NOT p STARTS WITH $pair_prefix] WITH r, r.rel_id AS rel_id, size(r.contrib_tasks) = 0 AND NOT coalesce(r.contrib_manual, false) AS orphan CALL (r, rel_id, orphan) { WITH r, rel_id WHERE orphan OPTIONAL MATCH (ri:RelationIdentity {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, rel_id: rel_id}) DELETE r, ri } RETURN count(*) AS revoked, sum(CASE WHEN orphan THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted

MATCH (n:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) WHERE $effective_task_ids IS NOT NULL AND ($task_id IN coalesce(n.contrib_tasks, []) OR EXISTS { (n)-[:EVIDENCED_BY {task_id: $task_id}]->(:Chunk {course_id: $course_id}) }) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[e:EVIDENCED_BY {task_id: $task_id}]->(:Chunk {course_id: $course_id}) DELETE e WITH DISTINCT n SET n.contrib_tasks = [t IN coalesce(n.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t <> $task_id] WITH n, size(n.contrib_tasks) = 0 AND NOT coalesce(n.contrib_manual, false) AS orphan CALL (n, orphan) { WITH n WHERE orphan OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}]-(:KnowledgePoint) OPTIONAL MATCH (ri:RelationIdentity {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, rel_id: r.rel_id}) DETACH DELETE ri, n } RETURN count(*) AS revoked, sum(CASE WHEN orphan THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted

UNWIND $nodes AS row OPTIONAL MATCH (existing:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, kp_id: row.kp_id}) WITH row, existing, coalesce(existing.locked, false) AS locked, existing IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce(existing.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(existing.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids)) AS was_visible CALL (row, locked) { WITH row WHERE NOT locked MERGE (n:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, kp_id: row.kp_id}) ON CREATE SET n.source = 'ai', n.locked = false, n.contrib_manual = false, n.contrib_tasks = [], n.revision = 0, n.level = 0 WITH row, n, CASE WHEN coalesce(n.status, '') IN ['approved', 'rejected'] THEN n.status ELSE row.status END AS status WITH row, n, status, n.name IS NULL OR n.name <> row.name OR n.type <> row.type OR n.definition <> row.definition OR n.confidence <> row.confidence OR coalesce(n.status, '') <> status OR coalesce(n.aliases, []) <> row.aliases AS changed SET n.name = row.name, n.type = row.type, n.definition = row.definition, n.confidence = row.confidence, n.status = status, n.aliases = row.aliases, n.revision = CASE WHEN changed THEN n.revision + 1 ELSE n.revision END, n.contrib_tasks = CASE WHEN $task_id IN n.contrib_tasks THEN n.contrib_tasks ELSE n.contrib_tasks + $task_id END WITH row, n UNWIND row.sources AS s MERGE (c:Chunk {course_id: $course_id, chunk_id: s.chunk_id}) ON CREATE SET c.document_id = s.document_id, c.revision_id = s.revision_id MERGE (n)-[:EVIDENCED_BY {task_id: $task_id, chunk_id: s.chunk_id, evidence_start: s.evidence_start, evidence_end: s.evidence_end}]->(c) } RETURN row.kp_id AS kp_id, locked, was_visible

MATCH (n:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) WHERE (coalesce(n.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(n.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) RETURN n.kp_id AS kp_id

MATCH (a:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) -[r:PREREQUISITE {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}]-> (b:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) WHERE coalesce(r.status, '') <> 'rejected' AND (coalesce(r.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(r.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(a.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(a.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(b.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(b.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) RETURN r.rel_id AS rel_id, a.kp_id AS from_id, b.kp_id AS to_id, coalesce(r.confidence, 0.0) AS confidence, r.source = 'ai' AND NOT coalesce(r.contrib_manual, false) AND r.status IN ['draft', 'low_confidence'] AS downgradable

UNWIND $rel_ids AS id MATCH (ri:RelationIdentity {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, rel_id: id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, kp_id: ri.from_id}) -[r {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, rel_id: id}]-> (b:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, kp_id: ri.to_id}) WHERE type(r) = ri.type RETURN id AS rel_id, ri.type AS type, ri.from_id AS from_id, ri.to_id AS to_id, r.status AS status, r IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce(r.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(r.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(a.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(a.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(b.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(b.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AS visible
MERGE (g:DraftWriteGuard {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) SET g.seq = coalesce(g.seq, 0) + 1 RETURN g.seq AS seq, size($effective_task_ids) AS visible_tasks

MATCH (n:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) WHERE (coalesce(n.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(n.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) RETURN n.kp_id AS kp_id

UNWIND $rel_ids AS id MATCH (ri:RelationIdentity {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, rel_id: id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, kp_id: ri.from_id}) -[r {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, rel_id: id}]-> (b:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id, kp_id: ri.to_id}) WHERE type(r) = ri.type RETURN id AS rel_id, ri.type AS type, ri.from_id AS from_id, ri.to_id AS to_id, r.status AS status, r IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce(r.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(r.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(a.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(a.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(b.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(b.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AS visible

MATCH (a:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) -[r:PREREQUISITE {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}]-> (b:KnowledgePoint {course_id: $course_id, version_id: $version_id}) WHERE coalesce(r.status, '') <> 'rejected' AND (coalesce(r.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(r.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(a.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(a.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) AND (coalesce(b.contrib_manual, false) OR any(t IN coalesce(b.contrib_tasks, []) WHERE t IN $effective_task_ids OR t IN $own_tasks)) RETURN r.rel_id AS rel_id, a.kp_id AS from_id, b.kp_id AS to_id
